exposure: Gestational diabetes diagnosis by IADPSG criteria
Gestational diabetes diagnosis by 1998 ADIPS criteria
Women diagnosed with GDM by ADIPS criteria and women diagnosed with GDM by IADPSG criteria
cohort: 3571 women who delivered singleton fetuses after 24 weeks' gestation between January 2011 and January 2014.
finding: Women diagnosed with GDM by the IADPSG criteria only (6% of the cohort) were more obese, delivered neonates on average 106 g heavier and had more fetal macrosomia than those with normal glucose tolerance.
